key_findings_relevant_to_project: Laser Doppler vibrometry (LDV) can non-destructively identify internal defects, including neck rot, in onion bulbs.
Single-point and scanning LDV measurements of bulb vibration response differ between defective and sound bulbs.
The authors emphasize controlled acquisition and cultivar-aware validation - internal-defect signatures must be validated per cultivar, not assumed universal.
how_this_project_uses_it: Design of dataset-acoustic/collection_protocol.md: controlled excitation, fixed geometry, per-onion IDs, repeatability checks.
It is NOT used as evidence that a phone speaker/microphone system detects onion internal rot - the paper uses laboratory LDV hardware.
